_**Lost Ark**_[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-1) is an online [MMO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massively_multiplayer_online_role-playing_game "Massively multiplayer online role-playing game")[action role-playing game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Action_role-playing_game "Action role-playing game")[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-wccftech-2)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-massivelyop-3) developed by [Smilegate RPG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smilegate "Smilegate"), a South Korean video game company.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-:1-4) It was revealed in South Korea on November 12, 2014 by Smilegate.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-5) On the first day of launch, the number of concurrent users was 250,000, and within the next week, the number of concurrent users exceeded 350,000.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-6) The game can be played in environments that support DirectX 9 or higher.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-:1-4) The Focus Group Test (FGT) was conducted behind closed doors in August 2015, the first [CBT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Closed_beta_test "Closed beta test") (Closed Beta Test) was held on August 24, 2016, the second CBT was held on September 15, 2017, and the final CBT was held on May 23, 2018, and the open beta test was conducted on November 7, 2018, and the official release was conducted on December 4, 2019.

It was released in Europe, North America and South America on February 11, 2022 by [Amazon Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Games "Amazon Games").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-wccftech-2)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-rpgsite-7)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-8) It achieved the second-highest concurrent player count of all games ever played on Steam with over 1.3 million players.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-verge-20220212-9) This led to long queues and a new server region for Europe was introduced.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-:0-10)_Lost Ark_ cost around US$85 million to develop.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-pulsenews_944582-11) The game received generally favorable reviews.

## Gameplay

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Gameplay")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/c/c0/Lost_Ark_gameplay_screenshot_March_07_2022.jpg/250px-Lost_Ark_gameplay_screenshot_March_07_2022.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lost_Ark_gameplay_screenshot_March_07_2022.jpg)

_Lost Ark_ gameplay

_Lost Ark_ is primarily focused on [player versus environment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_environment "Player versus environment") (PvE) and exploration (questing, achievement/collectible hunting, crafting, etc.). It features [player versus player](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_player "Player versus player") (PvP) elements as well.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-12) Players start by creating customizing their character, by choosing their appearance and from one of the six archetype classes — Warrior, Martial artist, Gunner, Mage, Assassin, Specialist — followed by one of their advanced classes. Reaching level 50 unlocks access to tiered [endgame](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/endgame "wikt:endgame") dungeons and raids, at which point most further progress is tied to the character's gear score.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-13)

### Classes

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Classes")]

Originally, 18 characters were introduced, but only 12 of them were released. Since then, the number has increased to 26.

### Combat System

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Combat System")]

The responsive and action-oriented combat system in Lost Ark is widely acclaimed as one of its defining features. It emphasizes the creation of fluid combos by chaining together various skills and attacks to effectively damage adversaries. With each class offering a diverse array of skills, players can experience distinct gameplay dynamics, as they adapt their abilities to combat sequences. Through the game's skill tree system, players can progressively unlock and enhance their character's abilities, enabling personalized customization to align with individual playstyles. This not only enhances the complexity of combat but also empowers players to refine their skills in accordance with their preferences.

## Development and release

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Development and release")]

_Lost Ark_'s development began in 2011 under the codename "Project T".[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-14)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-Unrealengine.com-15)[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-Hitc.com-16) The game uses [Unreal Engine 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unreal_Engine_3 "Unreal Engine 3").[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-17) It originally only supported [DirectX 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DirectX#DirectX_9 "DirectX")[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-18)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-19) but was updated to also support [DirectX 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DirectX_11 "DirectX 11") prior to the western release in 2022.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-20)

_Lost Ark_ was fully released in South Korea on December 4, 2019, and in North American, South American, and European regions on February 11, 2022, with [Amazon Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Games "Amazon Games") serving as the global publisher.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-21) Users that pre-purchased one of four founder's packs could play 3 days early on February 8, 2022.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-22)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-23)[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-24)[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-25) The game was initially unavailable in Belgium and the Netherlands due to the countries' stringent [loot box](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loot_box "Loot box") regulations,[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-26) with the latter later reversing its decision.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-27) Within twenty-four hours of its release, _Lost Ark_ became the second most played game on [Steam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steam_(service) "Steam (service)").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-verge-20220212-9)[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-28)

In 2021, there were plans between Smilegate and game publisher [HappyTuk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HappyTuk?action=edit&redlink=1 "HappyTuk (page does not exist)")[[zh](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%A8%82%E6%84%8F%E5%82%B3%E6%92%AD "zh:樂意傳播")] to launch _Lost Ark_ in [Taiwan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwan "Taiwan").[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-29) In January 2023, the Taiwanese servers' launch was put on hold,[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-30) and moved to a May 30, 2024 release date.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-31) The game's Japanese server was closed down on March 20, 2024.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-32)

_[PC Magazine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PCMag "PCMag")_ praised _Lost Ark_'s combat, writing, "Abilities look good, sound sufficiently powerful, and feel great to use. You can’t help but feel like a combat god when you divekick a crowd, and blast fodder monsters into bloody chunks."[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-PCM-43) Despite enjoying some of the minigames, _[Rock Paper Shotgun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rock\_Paper\_Shotgun "Rock Paper Shotgun")_ disliked the game's structure and felt, compared to other MMOs, _Lost Ark_ had little to offer: "Some may relish the chores, the gradual progress of the EXP bar, and the allure of shiny loot rewards... Yet, there's nothing I've seen so far in the game's questing and progression that makes it stand out from the competition."[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-45)_[PC Gamer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PC\_Gamer "PC Gamer")_ liked the combat abilities, but criticized the story: "_Lost Ark_ can be a captivating adventure, which makes it a shame that the main story is simply not that compelling. The central cast of characters are a largely one-dimensional carousel of exhaustingly noble heroes and villains."[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-PCGUS-40) The Western release was also criticized for its high volume of [bots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game_bot "Video game bot").[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-46)

_**Lost Ark**_[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-1) is an online [MMO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massively_multiplayer_online_role-playing_game "Massively multiplayer online role-playing game")[action role-playing game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Action_role-playing_game "Action role-playing game")[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-wccftech-2)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-massivelyop-3) developed by [Smilegate RPG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Smilegate "Smilegate"), a South Korean video game company.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-:1-4) It was revealed in South Korea on November 12, 2014 by Smilegate.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-5) On the first day of launch, the number of concurrent users was 250,000, and within the next week, the number of concurrent users exceeded 350,000.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-6) The game can be played in environments that support DirectX 9 or higher.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-:1-4) The Focus Group Test (FGT) was conducted behind closed doors in August 2015, the first [CBT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Closed_beta_test "Closed beta test") (Closed Beta Test) was held on August 24, 2016, the second CBT was held on September 15, 2017, and the final CBT was held on May 23, 2018, and the open beta test was conducted on November 7, 2018, and the official release was conducted on December 4, 2019.

It was released in Europe, North America and South America on February 11, 2022 by [Amazon Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Games "Amazon Games").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-wccftech-2)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-rpgsite-7)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-8) It achieved the second-highest concurrent player count of all games ever played on Steam with over 1.3 million players.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-verge-20220212-9) This led to long queues and a new server region for Europe was introduced.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-:0-10)_Lost Ark_ cost around US$85 million to develop.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-pulsenews_944582-11) The game received generally favorable reviews.

## Gameplay

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Gameplay")]

[![Image 5](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/c/c0/Lost_Ark_gameplay_screenshot_March_07_2022.jpg/250px-Lost_Ark_gameplay_screenshot_March_07_2022.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Lost_Ark_gameplay_screenshot_March_07_2022.jpg)

_Lost Ark_ gameplay

_Lost Ark_ is primarily focused on [player versus environment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_environment "Player versus environment") (PvE) and exploration (questing, achievement/collectible hunting, crafting, etc.). It features [player versus player](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_player "Player versus player") (PvP) elements as well.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-12) Players start by creating customizing their character, by choosing their appearance and from one of the six archetype classes — Warrior, Martial artist, Gunner, Mage, Assassin, Specialist — followed by one of their advanced classes. Reaching level 50 unlocks access to tiered [endgame](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/endgame "wikt:endgame") dungeons and raids, at which point most further progress is tied to the character's gear score.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-13)

### Classes

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Classes")]

Originally, 18 characters were introduced, but only 12 of them were released. Since then, the number has increased to 26.

### Combat System

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Combat System")]

The responsive and action-oriented combat system in Lost Ark is widely acclaimed as one of its defining features. It emphasizes the creation of fluid combos by chaining together various skills and attacks to effectively damage adversaries. With each class offering a diverse array of skills, players can experience distinct gameplay dynamics, as they adapt their abilities to combat sequences. Through the game's skill tree system, players can progressively unlock and enhance their character's abilities, enabling personalized customization to align with individual playstyles. This not only enhances the complexity of combat but also empowers players to refine their skills in accordance with their preferences.

## Development and release

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lost_Ark_(video_game)&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Development and release")]

_Lost Ark_'s development began in 2011 under the codename "Project T".[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-14)[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-Unrealengine.com-15)[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-Hitc.com-16) The game uses [Unreal Engine 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unreal_Engine_3 "Unreal Engine 3").[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-17) It originally only supported [DirectX 9](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DirectX#DirectX_9 "DirectX")[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-18)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-19) but was updated to also support [DirectX 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DirectX_11 "DirectX 11") prior to the western release in 2022.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-20)

_Lost Ark_ was fully released in South Korea on December 4, 2019, and in North American, South American, and European regions on February 11, 2022, with [Amazon Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Games "Amazon Games") serving as the global publisher.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-21) Users that pre-purchased one of four founder's packs could play 3 days early on February 8, 2022.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-22)[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-23)[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-24)[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-25) The game was initially unavailable in Belgium and the Netherlands due to the countries' stringent [loot box](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loot_box "Loot box") regulations,[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-26) with the latter later reversing its decision.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-27) Within twenty-four hours of its release, _Lost Ark_ became the second most played game on [Steam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steam_(service) "Steam (service)").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-verge-20220212-9)[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-28)

In 2021, there were plans between Smilegate and game publisher [HappyTuk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HappyTuk?action=edit&redlink=1 "HappyTuk (page does not exist)")[[zh](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%A8%82%E6%84%8F%E5%82%B3%E6%92%AD "zh:樂意傳播")] to launch _Lost Ark_ in [Taiwan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwan "Taiwan").[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-29) In January 2023, the Taiwanese servers' launch was put on hold,[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-30) and moved to a May 30, 2024 release date.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-31) The game's Japanese server was closed down on March 20, 2024.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lost_Ark_(video_game)#cite_note-32)
